selected_qualified_assessment.bearer_and_scope: A described agent together with its environment, observations, action channels and task, under an explicitly selected definition of agency.

selected_qualified_assessment.applicability_guard: Agency terminology is used to explain or compare behavior.
selected_qualified_assessment.material_premises: A task boundary can be stated without hiding a material human, tool or environmental dependency.

selected_qualified_assessment.constructed_positive_case: A thermostat is an agent under a situated feedback taxonomy while lacking the stronger mentalistic commitments of another account.
selected_qualified_assessment.constructed_failure_witness: Calling an entire service autonomous while its next action is selected by an undisclosed human makes the comparison indeterminate.
